notes.title: Full-Content Demo Available
notes.content:
[h1][b]Demo is Full-Content and polished[/b][/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666390/Gnarly_Hike/][h3][h1]TEST DEMO HERE[/h1][/h3][/url]

We took your feedback seriously and we polished the demo according to popular demand!
Thank you for your support and we suggest you check the demo again to see what we made together with your feedback as a community!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44721753/ba594b1e8255953634ccdec1729ca20cbf6f19f4.png[/img]

Changelog:
[list]
[*] Reduced lens flare by 50%
[*] Embedded Flashlight battery usage and Life in default HUD
[*] Changed Jumpscare mentality (more Phychological than chasing)
[*] Changed Door code clues to make more sense
[*] Changed Door code mechanic to be easier
[*] Included Hiding mechanic for extra terror
[*] Included Combat mechanic and Event to check that out too ːsteamhappyː
[/list]

Thanks again for your extremely valuable feedback <3 <3 <3
Cheers,

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2666390/Gnarly_Hike/][h3][h1]TEST DEMO HERE[/h1][/h3][/url]
